create_sampler_multi_task_trainer: create a SamplerMultiTaskTrainer instance with model, task list, optimizer params, and sampling method
train_sampler_multi_task_trainer: train a multi-task model using SamplerMultiTaskTrainer with uniform or proportional task sampling
